{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm to ensure accurate mean calculation
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Calculate mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_length = df_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Find the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_length.idxmax()
highest_mean_value = mean_flipper_length.max()

print('Mean flipper length by species:')
print(mean_flipper_length)
print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}')
print(f'Mean flipper length: {highest_mean_value:.2f} mm')"}
